01_case.notes: Open side up; supports in USB tunnel only if your slicer needs them.

02_switch_plate.notes: Visible face DOWN. 1.6 mm switch clip lands, 3 mm structural plate.

03_round_foot.notes: Flat bottom DOWN. Washer pockets face up; secure washers with tape before assembly.

04_joystick_cradle.notes: SUPERSEDED: old unretained cradle, retained only for original assembly compatibility. Use joystick-fit-v1 for bench testing; final plate mount pending.

05_touch_cap.notes: Visible face DOWN. Bond 13 mm copper disk immediately beneath the 0.8 mm top skin.

06_encoder_knob.notes: Socket DOWN; short bridging above nut pocket. Trial fit the D socket before pressing fully. Adhesive optional after testing.

07_led_baffle.notes: Black filament, cavity UP. LED PCB on floor, insulated pads underneath. Six identical cups.

08_keycap_1u.notes: Flat top, 0.5 mm beveled rim. Print 6 clear and 5 white, top UP; 0.10-0.12 mm layers with a 0.4 mm nozzle. Support underside as needed, keep sockets clear. Test one cap first.

09_keycap_2u_dual_stem.notes: Flat top, 0.5 mm beveled rim; white PETG, top UP. Support underside as needed, keep sockets clear. Two MX sockets 19.05 mm apart; fits two switches, not a centered stabilizer. Test fit first.

10_switch_fit_coupon.notes: Left/middle/right from top: 14.0 / 14.1 / 14.2 mm. Choose snug clip fit before full print.

11_stem_insert_coupon.notes: Cross fits -0.05 / nominal / +0.05, then 3.9 mm insert pocket. Sockets UP for inspection.

04_joystick_fit_holder_v1.notes: Bench sample only; not a drop-in plate mount. Flat bottom down, 0.20 mm layers.

04_shim_A_05_v1.notes: Starting shim A. Flat down, 0.10 mm layers; see fit guide for position.

04_shim_B_10_v1.notes: Starting shim B. Flat down, 0.10 mm layers; see fit guide for position.

04_shim_A_10_v1.notes: Optional fit adjustment only; do not stack with starting shim.

04_shim_B_05_v1.notes: Optional fit adjustment only; do not stack with starting shim.

04_joystick_corner_v2_PRINT_FIRST.notes: Physical fit pending; read joystick-integrated-v2/guide.html. Print the corner first.

02_integrated_top_plate_v2_WAIT.notes: Physical fit pending; read joystick-integrated-v2/guide.html. Print the corner first.

04_flat_joystick_corner_v3_PRINT_FIRST.notes: V3 flat mount; print the corner first. Read joystick-flat-v3/guide.html.

02_flat_top_plate_v3_WAIT.notes: V3 flat mount; print the corner first. Read joystick-flat-v3/guide.html.

07_baffle_clip_test_plate_v1.notes: Experimental fit candidate. Read baffle-snap-v1/guide.html; print two small samples first.

07_snap_baffle_v1.notes: Experimental fit candidate. Read baffle-snap-v1/guide.html; print two small samples first.

02_flat_joystick_snap_baffle_plate_WAIT.notes: Experimental fit candidate. Read baffle-snap-v1/guide.html; print two small samples first.

07_two_layer_top_sample.notes: White or clear PETG; supplied visible face DOWN, supports OFF. Pair with the lower sample; use two M3 × 20 screws and two M3 nuts.

07_two_layer_baffle_sample.notes: Black PETG; flat bottom DOWN, cups UP, supports OFF. Print one upper sample too. Test actual switches, LEDs, screw fit and wire clearance.

02_two_layer_top_plate_WAIT.notes: Wait for baffle and joystick samples. Underside DOWN, joystick seats UP. Review local support under shallow switch reliefs; full plate uses a different orientation from the small sample.

07_six_light_tray_WAIT.notes: One piece replaces six separate cups. Black PETG, flat bottom DOWN, cups UP. Four M3 × 20 screws and four ordinary exposed M3 nuts; physical fit pending.

07_heatset_baffle_sample_v3.notes: v3 uses M3 x 8 screws and M3 x 4 heat-set inserts; test pilot fit first.

07_heatset_six_light_tray_v3_WAIT.notes: v3 uses M3 x 8 screws and M3 x 4 heat-set inserts; test pilot fit first.
